errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва имената на четирите LLM: CoT, CoD, CCoT и CoUT, подредени от ляво надясно, съответно.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not labeled. The names of the models (LLMs) are provided in a legend at the bottom of the chart, which maps the model names to the colors of the bars.
The right vertical axis, representing 'Token Count', has labeled tick marks at intervals of 100 (0, 100, 200, etc., up to 800), not 50.
The minimum token count of 354.46 corresponds to the model CoUT (green bar), not CCoT (light blue bar), which has a token count of 445.91.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за всяко LLM са групирани заедно и представят резултатите за всеки модел.
errors.evidence: The chart is not a standard grouped bar chart. It consists of two separate bar plots side-by-side (one for 'Accuracy', one for 'Token Count'). The bars for a single model are not physically grouped together; rather, there is one bar for each model in each of the two plots.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the labels of the four language models, proceeding from left to right as CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT.
errors.evidence: This description is incomplete and misleading. The chart is divided into two sections (Accuracy and Token Count), and this sequence of four labels appears under each of the two corresponding groups of bars, not just once across the entire axis.
The tick labels on the 'Token Count' axis are at every 100-unit interval (0, 100, 200, etc.), not every 50.

errors.text_span: Four bars are present for each language model, each representing a different benchmark, and colored red, orange, light blue, and green respectively.
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart's structure. The chart does not show grouped bars. It shows two separate sets of individual bars. In each set (Accuracy and Token Count), there is only one bar per language model, not four.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar, with an approximate value of 80.89, is the red bar representing CoT.
errors.evidence: The bar with the value 80.89 is orange and represents 'CoD', not red and 'CoT'. The red 'CoT' bar has a value of 91.19 in the accuracy plot.

The chart axes and labels do not mention 'benchmarks'. This information is inferred from the paper's caption and not directly depicted in the figure, which violates the instruction to describe only what is shown.
The range of values for accuracy is from 80.89 (for CoD) to 91.19 (for CoT). The stated lower bound of 88.40 is incorrect.
The range of values for token count is from 354.46 (for CoUT) to 676.85 (for CoT). The stated upper bound of 445.91 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: Die Grafik zeigt als Balkendiagramm die durchschnittliche Leistung und Token-Anzahl von CoUT und seinen Baselines für 4 LRMs (Large Language Models) über 4 Benchmarks. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Modelle CoT, CoD, CCoT und CoUT, wobei sie in dieser Reihenfolge angeordnet sind.
errors.evidence: The description fails to identify the chart's structure, which consists of two distinct groups of four bars each (one group for 'Accuracy' and one for 'Token Count'). It incorrectly describes the chart as having a single set of four bars, each with two associated values, leading to widespread errors in data attribution.
The description states the right y-axis (Token Count) has tick marks every 50 tokens, but the axis labels (0, 100, 200, etc.) clearly show an interval of 100.
The description incorrectly assigns a token count of 534.24 to the CoT model. According to the chart, the token count for CoT is 676.85; the value 534.24 corresponds to the CoD model.
The description states the accuracy for CoD is 88.09, but the value shown on the chart is 80.89.
The description incorrectly assigns a token count of 445.91 to the CoD model. The chart shows the token count for CoD is 534.24; the value 445.91 corresponds to the CCoT model.
